title: Usual BMW quality with dealer support difficulty
summary: Reviews in this topic mostly describe familiar BMW quality and reliability expectations, with one mixed case citing an iDrive freeze and one undetermined mention of difficulty getting dealer assistance.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the car as excellent, spot on, and consistent with expected BMW quality.

mixed.summary: The mixed review is pleased with the car overall but reports an iDrive freeze that required a dealer hard reset.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention usual reliability, standard, functionality, and hard-to-get dealer assistance without enough context to confirm clear sentiment.

limitations: Several fragments are too short or vague to determine sentiment confidently.
The topic combines product quality, reliability, functionality, and dealer support, which are related but not fully consistent themes.
The sample is small and stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all owners.
